plan: [This is a second-price auction (pay the second-highest bid). Truthful bidding is weakly dominant: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others. No past rounds to learn from, values redraw each round, so bid my private value to win only when the second-highest bid is below my value. I will bid $40. ]

[In a second-price (Vickrey) auction, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy: you win when the second-highest bid is below your value and you pay that lower price. No past data helps here in a single independent draw. To maximize expected profit this round, I will bid my true value of $13.]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding my true private value is a dominant strategy: I win whenever the highest other bid is below my value and pay the second-highest bid, maximizing expected surplus. Values are independent and this is a single round, so no future learning matters. I will bid my value ($17) to maximize expected profit while avoiding overpayment.]
